$comment: The voice-state profile: what each agent state does to ANY pattern, as engine overrides. Compiled into the engine (crates/core_engine/src/voice_state.rs) and returned by `voiceStateProfile(pattern, state)`; the FX Spec resolver fills these into a 1.8+ file's voice-state entries for keys the file doesn't set, so an author patches the profile instead of restating it. `speed` multiplies the pattern's tuned speed; `overrides` are engine keys; `audioInput` tells a view which level to feed `audioLevel` (it is not an engine key). A negative `audioStrength` is the inward inhale, positive the outward swell. Per-pattern entries under `patterns` override the generic state for that pattern only.

simulated.$comment: Nothing here is simulated any more: `ink` and the listening inhale became engine keys in FX Spec 1.8, and the views' clock became phase-continuous on 2026-09-20 -- including the FX Spec path, so a state with its own `speed` keeps the pose. Kept as a field so tools reading it don't break.

glowing.$comment: Showcase base (aurora): the colour field flowing across the sphere is its own signal, so each state drives the flow speed, not just the tempo.

muted.$comment: hush dims itself (dim 0.6), so under the generic profile every state looked near-invisible. Here idle keeps a resting dim and the active states come up to full ink.

speaking.$comment: spectrum's bars already follow the audio, so listening (driven by the mic) read louder than speaking. Listening now sheds the particles and sits back; speaking gets the glow and the taller bars.

concluding.$comment: crystallize dissolves and re-forms on its own cycle, so at idle speed it spent seconds near-blank (studio-ui-ux measured 1461 -> 7 -> 739 ink over 7 s). A still, denser lattice raises the floor (min frame ink 0.25 -> 0.42) but cannot remove the gap without changing the mode -- it stays on the open list.

confirming.$comment: sonar is empty between pings, so idle showed nothing for most of a cycle. A bigger resting core and a shorter period keep something on screen.

calibrating.$comment: chladni's nodal figures are too fine to read at 64 px with the stock node size; the figures also hold still, which is the point, so the state shows through size and hold time instead of motion.

generating.$comment: shimmer is a track with a travelling highlight: speaking needs the brighter, longer highlight, or it reads quieter than listening.

exceptions.$comment: Patterns the generic state language doesn't fit. `fixed` ones have a tuned entry under `patterns`; `open` ones are still weak and say why, measured with a ladder (mean ink / motion / lowest single-frame ink, engine units, size 64).

glowing.was: aurora cycles its own hue, so the states drifted pink/blue
glowing.now: the showcase pins the colour; states differ by texture and energy (29/10 - 86/75 - 47/31 - 126/139)

muted.was: hush dims itself, so every state was near-invisible
muted.now: idle keeps a resting dim, active states come up (12 - 65 - 29 - 80)

calibrating.was: chladni's figures too fine to read at 64 px
calibrating.now: bigger nodes and a shorter hold per state (20 - 77 - 43 - 94)

confirming.was: sonar was empty between pings at idle (lowest frame ink 0.48)
confirming.now: a resting core and closer echoes; lowest frame ink 3.79
confirming.note: Without voice states (the bare pattern) sonar still empties between pings -- that is the pattern's own cycle, and the profile only applies when a state is set.

speaking.was: spectrum's bars follow the mic too, so listening read louder than speaking
speaking.now: listening sheds its particles and sits back (10 vs speaking 23), but it still measures close to thinking (12) -- the bars are the same shape in both

generating.issue: shimmer is a thin track with a travelling highlight, so there is little to modulate: speaking (6) still doesn't beat listening (10) or thinking (10). It needs its own speaking treatment in the mode, not more overrides.

concluding.issue: crystallize dissolves completely inside its cycle, so a single frame can still be near-blank (lowest frame ink 0.42 at idle, 0.96 while speaking). A still, denser lattice raised the floor but only the mode can remove the gap.
concluding.note: Same caveat as `confirming`: the bare pattern empties on its own cycle; the profile's denser lattice only applies when a state is set.

shaping.issue: morph changes between circle, square and triangle by design, which cuts against 'one shape stays on screen'. Fine as a standalone pattern, wrong as a voice base.

signal-family.note: they already carry voice states through `voiceStateCode` and the audio bands, so the profile only lends them ink, glow and tempo; their own behaviour is left alone.

value-driven-rings.was: thinking equalled idle: nothing moves, so there was no tempo to raise
value-driven-rings.now: the profile's pulse carries it (e.g. completing idle motion 1.8 vs thinking 13.9); the value itself is never touched
